title: Harrods Traditional Teddy Bear 17 Inch Christmas Bear W/ Green Bow Tie And Paws
descriptionText: Celebrate the holidays in style with this limited edition Harrods Traditional Teddy Bear named Andrew. Made from soft velvet material and featuring brown eyes, this 17 inch Christmas bear comes with a green bow tie and paws, perfect for adding a touch of festive charm to your home decor. Whether you're looking to add to your collection or give a gift that will be treasured for years to come, this plush bear is sure to delight. Part of the Anniversary Collection and manufactured in 1995, this vintage bear is a must-have for any Harrods enthusiast.
